items.title: 面向生产的 AgentOps：小红书 AI Agent 应用工程化实践｜QCon北京
items.raw_excerpt: 4 月 16 日-4 月 18 日， QCon 全球软件开发大会 将在北京举办。本届大会锚定 Agentic AI 时代的软件工程重塑，聚焦 Agentic AI、多智能体协作、算力优化、技术债治理、多模态和 AI 原生基础设施等前沿话题，邀请来自腾讯、阿里、百度、华为、蚂蚁、小米、网易等企业技术专家，带来百余项真实落地案例，系统性分享前沿洞察与实战干货，以技术共创探索 AI 落地新路径。

title_i18n.zh: 面向生产的 AgentOps：小红书 AI Agent 应用工程化实践｜QCon北京
title_i18n.en: Production-Oriented AgentOps: Xiaohongshu's Engineering Practices for AI Agent Applications | QCon Beijing
title_i18n.es: AgentOps Orientado a la Producción: Prácticas de Ingeniería en la Aplicación de Agentes de IA en Xiaohongshu｜QCon Beijing

excerpt_i18n.zh: 4 月 16 日-4 月 18 日， QCon 全球软件开发大会 将在北京举办。本届大会锚定 Agentic AI 时代的软件工程重塑，聚焦 Agentic AI、多智能体协作、算力优化、技术债治理、多模态和 AI 原生基础设施等前沿话题，邀请来自腾讯、阿里、百度、华为、蚂蚁、小米、网易等企业技术专家，带来百余项真实落地案例，系统性分享前沿洞察与实战干货，以技术共创探索 AI 落地新路径。
excerpt_i18n.en: From April 16 to 18, the QCon Global Software Development Conference will be held in Beijing. This edition focuses on reshaping software engineering in the Agentic AI era, highlighting cutting-edge topics such as Agentic AI, multi-agent collaboration, computing power optimization, technical debt management, multimodal AI, and AI-native infrastructure. The event invites technical experts from companies including Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi, and NetEase to present over a hundred real-world implementation cases. They will systematically share forward-looking insights and practical expertise, fostering collaborative innovation to explore new pathways for AI implementation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Del 16 al 18 de abril, la conferencia global de desarrollo de software QCon se celebrará en Pekín. Esta edición se centra en la reconfiguración de la ingeniería de software en la era de la IA agéntica, abordando temas de vanguardia como la IA agéntica, la colaboración multiagente, la optimización de la potencia computacional, la gestión de la deuda técnica, la multimodalidad y la infraestructura nativa de IA. Se invitará a expertos técnicos de empresas como Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi y NetEase, quienes presentarán más de cien casos prácticos reales, compartiendo sistemáticamente perspectivas avanzadas y conocimientos aplicados, explorando nuevas vías para la implementación de la IA mediante la colaboración tecnológica.

items.title: How are you keeping AI coding agents from burning money?
items.raw_excerpt:
My agents retry a bit more than it should, and there goes my bill up in the sky.
I tried figuring out what is causing this but none of the tools helped much. and the worse thing for me is that everything shows up as aggregate usage. Total tokens, total cost, maybe per model. So I ended up hacking together a thin layer in front of OpenAI where every request is forced to carry some context (agent, task, user, team), and then just logging and calculating cost per call and putting some basic limits on top so you can actually block something if it starts going off the rails.

excerpt_i18n.zh:
我的代理重试次数比应有的多，导致账单飙升。
我试图找出原因，但所有工具都没能提供太多帮助。更糟的是，所有数据都显示为聚合状态。

Mis agentes reintentan un poco más de lo debido, y ahí se dispara mi factura por las nubes.

Currently, the AI industry is shifting from competition in model capabilities to competition in large-scale applications. Application forms have also expanded from single Q&A to multi-agent collaboration, long-chain reasoning, and composite task execution, driving rapid growth in Token demand. Meanwhile, equipment and energy costs during computing power procurement, deployment, and operation continue to rise, leading to an increasingly prominent mismatch between computing power investment and actual Token output. System optimization focused on Token inference efficiency has become a key factor in promoting the industry's sustainable development.

Against this backdrop, Approaching.AI, a globally leading high-efficiency AI Token production service provider, recently launched its new-generation AI inference platform—Approaching.AI Token as a Service (ATaaS). This platform addresses industry challenges such as the difficulty in converting substantial hardware investments into high-quality Token production capacity, as well as prominent resource waste and cost inefficiencies.

To tackle current industry issues, the Approaching.AI ATaaS platform leverages four self-developed core technology modules to build end-to-end capabilities covering heterogeneous integration, intelligent scheduling, and elastic scaling. It encapsulates computing power and energy into layered, application-specific high-efficiency Token services, providing a benchmark Chinese solution for enhancing the quality and efficiency of domestic computing power, breaking down heterogeneous computing silos, and achieving large-scale cost reduction and efficiency improvement.

excerpt_i18n.en: Tokens are doubling every two weeks, and AI infrastructure is being rewritten. "Such growth rates are rare in human history," says Xia Lixue, CEO of Wu Wen Xin Qiong, describing his most immediate impression of the current AI industry. Following the trend of "shrimp farming," the AI industry is undergoing an even more interesting shift: demand-side forces are reshaping AI infrastructure from the ground up. Consequently, token usage is skyrocketing, computing power supply and demand are mismatched, and system architectures are under pressure—issues once confined to the underlying layers are now becoming key variables in industry development. On March 27, at the 2026 Zhongguancun Forum Annual Meeting—AI Open Source Frontier Forum, a deep dialogue was led by Yang Zhilin, founder of Moonshot AI, with participants including Zhang Peng, CEO of Zhipu AI; Xia Lixue, co-founder and CEO of Wu Wen Xin Qiong; Luo Fuli, head of Xiaomi's MiMo large model; and Huang Chao, assistant professor and doctoral supervisor at the University of Hong Kong, and head of the Nanobot team. They discussed topics such as the current wave of intelligent agents and the evolution of AI infrastructure. As a representative of the infrastructure layer, Xia Lixue shared his observations and reflections on this round of AI transformation from the perspective of token supply and industrial sustainability. Token explosion: reminiscent of data traffic in the 3G era. In Xia Lixue's view, tokens are no longer just a billing unit but are becoming a fundamental production factor akin to "electricity" or "data traffic." He compares this phase to the early days of the 3G era. When mobile internet first became widespread, users quickly realized that a monthly 100MB data plan was far from sufficient.
excerpt_i18n.es: "Los tokens se duplican cada dos semanas", la infraestructura de IA está siendo reescrita. "Este ritmo de crecimiento es raro en la historia humana". Esta es la percepción más directa de Xia Lixue, CEO de Wu Wen Xin Qiong, sobre la industria actual de IA. Después de que "criar camarones" se convirtiera en una tendencia, la industria de IA ha entrado en un cambio aún más interesante: la demanda está remodelando inversamente la infraestructura de IA. Como resultado, el volumen de llamadas de tokens se dispara, la oferta y demanda de potencia de cálculo se desajustan y la arquitectura del sistema se ve presionada; estos problemas, originalmente subyacentes, se están convirtiendo en variables clave para el desarrollo de la industria. title_i18n.zh: 绿色 IT ：如何减轻 AI 对环境的影响

title_i18n.es: Tecnología verde: cómo mitigar el impacto ambiental de la IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: AI poses significant challenges to green IT: each query consumes substantial energy, GPU chips have a lifespan of only 2-3 years, and users are unaware of the associated costs.
excerpt_i18n.es: La IA plantea un gran desafío para la informática verde: cada consulta consume una cantidad significativa de energía, la vida útil de los chips GPU es de solo 2 a 3 años, y los usuarios no perciben los costos asociados.

items.title: Agent 生产落地基石：可观测透视 + 评估飞轮的一体化建设实践｜QCon北京
items.raw_excerpt: 4 月 16 日-4 月 18 日， QCon 全球软件开发大会 将在北京举办。本届大会锚定 Agentic AI 时代的软件工程重塑，聚焦 Agentic AI、多智能体协作、算力优化、技术债治理、多模态和 AI 原生基础设施等前沿话题，邀请来自腾讯、阿里、百度、华为、蚂蚁、小米、网易等企业技术专家，带来百余项真实落地案例，系统性分享前沿洞察与实战干货，以技术共创探索 AI 落地新路径。

title_i18n.zh: Agent 生产落地基石：可观测透视 + 评估飞轮的一体化建设实践｜QCon北京
title_i18n.en: Agent Production Implementation Foundation: Integrated Practice of Observable Transparency and Evaluation Flywheel | QCon Beijing
title_i18n.es: Piedra angular de la implementación de producción de Agent: práctica integrada de observabilidad transparente y rueda de evaluación | QCon Beijing

excerpt_i18n.zh: 4 月 16 日-4 月 18 日， QCon 全球软件开发大会 将在北京举办。本届大会锚定 Agentic AI 时代的软件工程重塑，聚焦 Agentic AI、多智能体协作、算力优化、技术债治理、多模态和 AI 原生基础设施等前沿话题，邀请来自腾讯、阿里、百度、华为、蚂蚁、小米、网易等企业技术专家，带来百余项真实落地案例，系统性分享前沿洞察与实战干货，以技术共创探索 AI 落地新路径。
excerpt_i18n.en: From April 16 to 18, the QCon Global Software Development Conference will be held in Beijing. This edition focuses on reshaping software engineering in the Agentic AI era, highlighting cutting-edge topics such as Agentic AI, multi-agent collaboration, computing power optimization, technical debt management, multimodal AI, and AI-native infrastructure. The conference invites technical experts from companies including Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi, and NetEase to present over a hundred real-world implementation cases. They will systematically share forward-looking insights and practical experiences, exploring new pathways for AI implementation through collaborative technological innovation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Del 16 al 18 de abril, la conferencia global de desarrollo de software QCon se celebrará en Pekín. Esta edición se centra en la reconfiguración de la ingeniería de software en la era de la IA agéntica, abordando temas de vanguardia como la IA agéntica, la colaboración multiagente, la optimización de la potencia computacional, la gestión de la deuda técnica, la multimodalidad y la infraestructura nativa de IA. Se invitará a expertos técnicos de empresas como Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Huawei, Ant Group, Xiaomi y NetEase, quienes presentarán más de cien casos prácticos reales, compartiendo sistemáticamente perspectivas avanzadas y conocimientos aplicados, explorando nuevas vías para la implementación de la IA mediante la colaboración tecnológica.
